description: Murree Brewery Company Limited is a beverage manufacturer established in 1860 at Ghora Galli in the Pir Panjal range, whose registered office and main brewery are now at 3-National Park Road, Rawalpindi. The company produces beers, whiskies, gins, vodkas, rums and brandies, and has extended into non-alcoholic beverages through its Tops Food & Beverages and Murree Sparkletts divisions, with a Murree Glass division as well. Its corporate information page lists factories at Rawalpindi and in the Hattar Industrial Estate, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
headOffice: 3-National Park Road, Chaklala Cantt, Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan

products.name: Beer
products.summary: Beers including Murree Beer, Classic Beer, Millennium Beer, Wheat Beer, Special Strong brew, Stout Beer and Lite Export Pils.

products.name: Whisky
products.summary: Whiskies including twelve- and eight-year-old single malts, Murree's Vat No.1, Vintage Gold and Millennium Reserve.

products.name: Gin, vodka, rum and brandy
products.summary: Spirits including Silver Top Gin, Sapphire Gin, Murree's Vodka, Green Apple Vodka, Bolskaya Vodka, Murree's Finest Rum and Doctor's Brandy.

products.name: Bigg carbonated drinks
products.summary: Non-alcoholic fruit carbonated drinks in the Bigg family, in 250 ml and 300 ml cans and larger bottles.

products.name: Tops juices
products.summary: Juices and nectars produced by the Tops Food & Beverages division, offered as Tetra Pak, nectar and juice-in-pouch lines.

products.name: Murree Sparkletts bottled water
products.summary: Drinking water bottled at Hattar in 330 ml, 500 ml, 1.5 L, 5 L, 12 L and 19 L sizes, plus alkaline water and glass-bottled still and sparkling water.
